answer: Admission requires a quorum of three established guardians, each staking part of their own standing on the newcomer, as trees in a grove vouch for a sapling. Each guardian may vouch for only a few newcomers per epoch, and if the newcomer proves fake, every guardian stake is slashed. The admission cipher is a signed endorsement bound to one key, single-use and uncopyable. An attacker must therefore earn scarce guardian slots per fake identity, spending real timber - reputation and stake - identity by identity, with nothing shared or parallelised.
